reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. The spec deviation is confirmed: `whenTokensSupplied` modifier is defined in `LegionAbstractSale` and even used on other functions (L203), yet is absent from `claimTokenAllocation` (L251-313), while `LegionPreLiquidApprovedSale.claimTokenAllocation` (L409) explicitly adds it — demonstrating design intent for the guard. The primary attack path (token drain + permanent `hasSettled = true`) requires the project to accidentally send `askToken` directly to the contract before `supplyTokens` is called, so the attacker cannot independently force exploitation; this conditionality prevents CONFIRMED_VULNERABILITY. Severity kept at High per scope thresholds (High Impact + Medium Likelihood), affecting all three in-scope sale types that inherit the unguarded base implementation.
